#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>

using namespace std;

int countPossibilities(vector<char>& s, char x) {
    for (int i = 0; i < s.size(); i++) {
        if (s[i] == 'X') s[i] = x;
    }
    if (s[0] == '0') return 0;
    int possibilities = 1;
    bool firstXSeen = true;
    for (int i = 0; i < s.size(); i++) {
        if (s[i] == '_') {
            possibilities *= (i == 0) ? 9 : 10;
        } else if (s[i] == 'X' && firstXSeen) {
            possibilities *= (i == 0) ? 9 : 10;
            firstXSeen = false;
        }
    }
    return possibilities;
}

bool checkReplacementValidity(const vector<char>& s, char a, char b) {
    int n = s.size();
    if (n >= 2) {
        if (s[n - 2] >= '0' && s[n - 2] <= '9' && s[n - 2] != a) return false;
        if (s[n - 1] >= '0' && s[n - 1] <= '9' && s[n - 1] != b) return false;
        if (s[n - 2] == 'X' && s[n - 1] == 'X' && a != b) return false;
    }
    return true;
}

int main() {
    string input;
    getline(cin, input);
    vector<char> s(input.begin(), input.end());

    if (s.size() < 2) {
        char c = s[0];
        if (c == '0' || c == '_' || c == 'X') {
            cout << 1 << endl;
        } else {
            cout << 0 << endl;
        }
    } else {
        int totalOptions = 0;
        vector<pair<char, char>> replacements = { {'0', '0'}, {'2', '5'}, {'5', '0'}, {'7', '5'} };
        for (auto& rep : replacements) {
            if (checkReplacementValidity(s, rep.first, rep.second)) {
                vector<char> t = s;
                t[t.size() - 2] = rep.first;
                t[t.size() - 1] = rep.second;
                if (s[s.size() - 2] == 'X') {
                    totalOptions += countPossibilities(t, t[t.size() - 2]);
                } else if (s[s.size() - 1] == 'X') {
                    totalOptions += countPossibilities(t, t[t.size() - 1]);
                } else {
                    totalOptions += countPossibilities(t, 'X');
                }
            }
        }
        cout << totalOptions << endl;
    }
    return 0;
}
